messages:
maya: Heads-up - AcmeCorp POC encountered intermittent 503s + SAML failures during 10k-qps soak. Kicking off war-room.
chris: can you paste a failing request id and logs?
maya: sample logs: 
```
[2026-06-01T14:12:03Z] ERROR request_id=abcd-1234 model_call status=503 backend=runtime-node-7 message=\"kv cache overflow\"
[2026-06-01T14:12:04Z] WARN request_id=abcd-1234 auth status=401 saml_callback=timeout
```
sam: same 503 pattern on swarm nodes. CPU/GPU are fine; runtime shows repeated "KV cache overflow" then retry storms.
alex: is this the long-prefix, parallel chat workload from the replay?
maya: yes — multi-tenant demo, ~60-token prefixes and ~10 concurrent calls/user. We enabled prefix caching but eviction may be thrashing.
chris: mitigation idea: lower max_concurrent_streams to 4 and set aggressive prefix eviction. I'll push a canary to the dedicated pool.
jen: customer demo at 16:00, need timeline for patch.
chris: 15m to roll canary + 5m validation.
sam: auth provider also showing slow callbacks, causing retries. Can we return 429 on transient auth failures instead of triggering retries?
alex: we should also add a retry budget in the client proxy to prevent amplification. I'll prepare a small proxy config change.
maya: on the customer call — they see 401s then a flood of retries. Disabling automatic retry on 401 should reduce pressure.
chris: pushing canary:
```
service: runtime-pool-dedicated
config:
  max_concurrent_streams: 4
  prefix_cache:
    eviction_policy: aggressive
  client_proxy:
    retry_on_401: false
```
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for runtime-pool-dedicated (canary id: can-6882)
sam: monitoring — token throughput dipped but 503 rate decreasing. 401s still present but retry amplification lower.
maya: customer says demo is partially unblocked but still seeing auth failures. They want root cause and whether SAML is supported at scale.
chris: root-cause draft: auth-provider latency spikes + large prefix retention causing eviction/rehydration -> KV cache saturation -> 503s. Actions: short-term: canary + disable retry on 401; mid-term: retry budget + backoff jitter in proxy; long-term: autoscale prefix cache by active-prefix cardinality and expose sizing guidance to sales.
alex: I'll write a POC runbook addendum with recommended settings (concurrency limits, prefix lengths, retry budgets). Will link draft after call.
jen: pricing note — customer requests a dedicated warm pool for demo days. Increasing cache capacity affects reserved GPU sizing. I'll coordinate with sales ops on an interim offer.
maya: please include sample config + cost delta. They need go/no-go within 24h.
chris: follow-ups: I'll open an internal ticket with logs + a replay harness to reproduce. Sam, can you capture metric windows for the SAML timeouts?
sam: will grab graphs and attach to ticket.
maya: staying on the call to confirm customer sees stability. Will update thread with final decision. :thumbsup:
